synthesizer_contract.inputs: Only the five separately frozen M27 role RAW files.
synthesizer_contract.reconciliation_rule: Resolve by evidence scope, assumptions, nogoods, propagation and falsifiers; never by majority.

reconciliation.issue: Historical P0 structure remains resolvable while current semantic/current-universe certification is incomplete.
reconciliation.resolution: Preserve P0 as historical evidence; current equivalence requires separate governed attestation.

reconciliation.issue: Performance has measurable rows but incompatible/ambiguous timing semantics.
reconciliation.resolution: Retain descriptive measurements only; no causal performance conclusion.

reconciliation.issue: Authority labels are distinct but material independence is unproven.
reconciliation.resolution: Keep label-level separation as evidence and block stronger independence claim.

reconciliation.issue: Innovation finds existing evidence surfaces and no demonstrated runtime defect.
reconciliation.resolution: Prefer reuse-first verification; do not expand into runtime intervention.

integrated_findings.claim: P0 is internally coherent historical inventory evidence, and all 38 frozen caller names plus 21 frozen trigger names remain structurally resolvable.

Current semantic equivalence is not certified: 22/38 empirical md5(prosrc) differ, canonical historical hash representation is not demonstrated, and the bounded current name scan exposes complements and omissions relative to P0.
Performance evidence is descriptive only because zero/null semantics, matched intervention boundaries, reuse effects and non-additive chunk timings remain unresolved.

The research principal is read-only for IG execution; recorded Curator/Validator identity fields are distinct where both exist, but material independence and canonical historical operation linkage are not demonstrated.
Existing cache/context/manifest/receipt surfaces support a reuse-first evidence strategy; no runtime repair, new observability subsystem or duplicate-body removal is justified by current evidence.

assumptions.text: P0 is historical as-of evidence, not current certification.
md5(prosrc) is empirical until canonical historical hash serialization is proved.
Name-pattern/static graphs are discovery surfaces, not authoritative runtime universes.
Recorded identity inequality is weaker than material execution independence.
Performance timing semantics and intervention boundaries must be explicit before causal inference.
Existing safe evidence surfaces should be reused before adding runtime mechanisms.

minimal_justifications.claim: Authority/material independence requires more than labels

nogoods.if: Canonical historical hash method differs from md5(prosrc).
invalidate: Any strong current-body drift conclusion from the 16/22 split

nogoods.if: Authoritative current universe classifies bounded complements as non-material or reveals other material consumers.
invalidate: Any totality claim from the bounded name scan

nogoods.if: Curator/Validator labels map to one effective execution principal/session.
invalidate: Any material-independence claim based on identity fields

nogoods.if: Timing contracts show zeros/components are semantically valid and matched replay controls workload/reuse.
Existing evidence surfaces cannot safely produce required current evidence.

propagation.result: Retain name resolution; downgrade body-drift semantics to UNKNOWN.
Recompute current coverage from authoritative manifest; discard bounded-scan totality.
Escalate authority issue and invalidate material-independence support.
Permit a controlled performance decision from matched evidence.
Classify a bounded evidence-surface gap; still no domain repair until attributable defect exists.

alternative_supports: A governed current manifest can close architecture/coverage without runtime mutation.
Canonical operation/provenance evidence can close authority without privilege widening.
Controlled matched replay can close performance without assuming historical clocks are comparable.

E.rationale: No material runtime defect is demonstrated, but current semantic equivalence, current-universe completeness and material authority separation are not closed. Performance remains NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE inside the verification path.
potential_falsifiers: Governed current manifest proves semantic equivalence and complete material consumer classification.
Canonical provenance proves valid authority and material Curator/Validator independence.
Controlled matched performance replay proves or excludes a material regression.

reversal_criteria.to_REPAIR_REQUIRED: Governed verification proves a material active defect with an attributable minimal target.
reversal_criteria.to_NO_ACTION_SUPPORTED: Currentness, coverage, authority and performance unknowns close without material defect.
reversal_criteria.to_NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE: Required governed evidence remains inaccessible or ambiguous.

constraints_preserved: P0 historical facts separated from post-cut observations
Five role RAWs frozen before synthesis
unresolved: Current active-entry mapping and semantic equivalence
Matched performance semantics and intervention boundary
